stand.description: InkPuppet.STAND — the neutral pose the draw-in reveals and every clip departs from

draw_in.description: the pencil sketches the six parts in, one after another

march.description: marches on the spot — travelling nowhere, which is the joke under 'same distance'

walk.description: walks; the world slides left past it

walk_mirrored.description: walks back the other way; actor scaleX -1, world slides right

shuffle.description: a slow sneaking creep — aimless searching of an empty room

kick.description: kicks the box that will not open

sit.description: sits down defeated, and stands back up on its own before the last beat

metadata.source: pose_library_builder produced the first draft. It was replaced because its default poses (blink, look_left, surprised) describe a face this character does not have. A mocap-driven figure has no pose library in the usual sense — it has one neutral pose and a list of clips.
metadata.clip_repeat_check: walk is used twice and never back to back; shuffle separates them and the second is mirrored.
